versions.subject: Create image_load_side_load_wwlib.yml
versions.detection:
selection:
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '\wwlib.dll'
filter:
    ImageLoaded|startswith:
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Office\'
        - 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft Office\'
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: ImageLoaded="*\\wwlib.dll" NOT (ImageLoaded IN ("C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Microsoft Office\\*", "C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft Office\\*"))

versions.subject: chore: update metadata and filter
versions.detection:
selection:
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '\wwlib.dll'
filter_main_path:
    Image|startswith:
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Office\'
        - 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft Office\'
    Image|endswith: '\winword.exe'
    ImageLoaded|startswith:
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Office\'
        - 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft Office\'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: ImageLoaded="*\\wwlib.dll" NOT (Image IN ("C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Microsoft Office\\*", "C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft Office\\*") Image="*\\winword.exe" ImageLoaded IN ("C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Microsoft Office\\*", "C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft Office\\*"))
